scope: Physical LAN; TCP/UDP active cancellation and fresh HTTP/UDP recovery. Not WAN, lock/wake, throughput or sustained resource qualification.

udpCancellation.control: delayed nonce response must pass without cancellation
udpCancellation.afterCancellation: pending reply must not reach probe; idempotent close must accept zero; fresh HTTP/UDP must recover

clockScope: Backend/dispatch durations share the host clock. Supplemental device-error delays mix uncalibrated device/host epoch clocks and are diagnostic estimates, not precision API latency.
